scheme_name: Grant for the Repair of House (BBOCWWB)
other_conditions: Must be registered with the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
Must have at least three years of continuous membership, active at the time of application.
Must not have already received financial assistance for house construction, bicycles, or tools.
Assistance is provided only once per eligible worker.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹20,000 is provided to registered construction workers for house repairs.
